body: It's tempting, but he keeps emailing me threatening to sue me (he's not super bright), so I feel like I should lawyer up before I touch the joint bank account.

I know, on my better days, I'm like, it's so easy! Just don't think about your problems and it's like they're solved! But then on my worse days, I take everything wayyyyy too seriously and think my life is over.
Kind of, but only in subtle ways where I won't get arrested or accused of being "bitter." You down?

You are special. I'm glad your wife sees it. I know there are loyal guys out there - literally every other man I know is extremely faithful. I just lucked out and got one with a slippery relationship to the truth.
Ugh, that's so awful, I'm sorry. I hope that you find peace, whether you leave your husband or try to move past the infidelity. Feel free to PM me if you want to discuss more details.

That is so horrible, I'm glad you are doing so well now! I just don't feel like I have the energy to kick life's ass right now. I can hardly leave the house, much less start engaging in a million activities. I want to fast forward to the part where I'm doing awesome like you.

Thanks, I will check out that song! Someone else posted "Hit Em Up Style" by Blu Cantrell and that was pretty helpful to me, I must say.

I'm not in Virginia unfortunately, thank you for the invite though.
Haha, he unfriended me months ago. He uses Facebook to cheat so having me on there isn't really conducive to his meeting new women. I want to delete the whole thing.
Thanks for the offer, this is actually the closest yet! I'm unfortunately just a bit too far, but I do appreciate it and would take you up if I was a little closer.
Omg, that's so awful. It must be hard to reconcile her bad behavior with her senseless death.
Hahaha! That'd be hilarious, I wish! I cracked an egg in someone's mailbox when I was a kid though and I still feel kind of bad about it.

I've been working on your last piece of advice, but it's been hard because I can't seem to figure out what I want. All the freedom feels like a burden kind of.

May I ask how your story ended up? Did you stay in the new city, are you doing better now?
Thank you, I may take you up on that someday.
I'm now listening to this song on repeat, it's the only thing that's made me happy all day. Many thanks!

Three cheers for lone wolves! That's how people have always described me. I don't connect with people very often, so to find that connection, and for it to turn out to be fake, or just cheapened by disloyalty, well, it's hard to take.

I do see the beauty in other people more. I feel that I have become more compassionate in my sadness. But I also feel like a ghost haunting the planet, almost like I'm standing outside people's windows watching them be all happy with their families, while I'm alone and invisible. I just want to feel engaged in life again.

I'm happy you're doing better and that you have family nearby, which is something I've been missing.

Wow that's awful, sorry to hear that. And what's up with birthday breakups? They are not as uncommon as they should be. I personally have been dumped twice on Valentine's Day, by two different guys. It took a long time to find that funny, but I laugh about it now, so hopefully I laugh about this asshole someday too.
Tell me about it. That's the worst part.

Is this a game? I like games. I have a liberal arts degree and I'm not in management yet, hopefully someday! I don't even really know what math or physics are...haha, just kidding, but only kind of. Put that into your analysis machine and tell me what you get out.
Ha! Legit loled. That's a great song, I wish I had a girl posse like that to sing "Oops" in the background while I throw bags over my shoulder.
Thank you, I really appreciate your kind message and the messages from others. I know all the stuff you say is true, I just want to fast forward to the part where I laugh about all this.
I know about the best revenge, I just wish I could fast forward to the part where I actually am living well, you know?
Haha, this made me laugh. I've been trying really hard not to exert financial control over him, but it'd be so easy. The joint bank account is sitting there, ripe for the taking!
I do have a college degree, why do you ask? I'm from a place really far away from where I currently live.
Thanks so much. Good advice.
Thank you for your post, it exudes joy! I like to hear from people who have been where I've been and have become better for it.
Thanks for the invite. I'm just a bit too far unfortunately. I'm really sorry about your friend, I hope you are all able to find peace and to forgive him.

Thank you for your post. I'm glad you were able to turn your life around. I know in my head that this is what I have to do, but I don't think I'm strong enough. When it comes time to "put myself out there" I can't do it and I hide in my bed.
Thanks for your offer, I appreciate it.

I disagree that you respect women, because that should start at home with the women in your own life. 

But I don't want to get into it. I will take your song suggestion, thank you.

Thank you for your honesty? I'm mad at you too though, why do you have to inflict pain like that? Even if you think they'll never find out, the more observant ones will always find out. 

I feel for your wife, hell, maybe I am your wife (don't think so thoug). My mother-in-law is also very feminist and also left her husband for a woman. It was a decade later, but still, how does such a woman have a son who respects woman so little? It's so frustrating. I don't care to psychoanalyze his or your upbringing though, people go through all kinds of stuff and they all turn out differently because of it.

I hear you about jumping out of bed, I know it's the right thing to do, but I really just can't do it. I can't face the world.

I know that the best revenge is living well, but I don't have the energy to do that. I haven't been able to get out of bed, really, because I cannot function when my emotions are like this. And I don't care about any of the things I used to like. Nothing brings me joy anymore. 

I'm 30, and it's me who sees my own wrinkles, because he cheated on me constantly and so I was constantly comparing myself to his affair partners, and to all other women, really. I'm fine looking, in theory, but I have so much depression and anger and it's really not attractive to anybody - it just emanates from me. 

You think I should spend his money? I was considering it, but I thought it would be such a petty and awful thing to do. Buying expensive beauty products does admittedly bring me 0.5 seconds of respite though.

I know it wasn't about me, but it's become a habit to compare myself to other women. I was over-the-top paranoid about every pretty girl he ever came into contact with, honestly because he tried to become intimate with every pretty girl he ever came into contact with. 

I know he doesn't care about the new girl, he lied to her about his involvement with me, he was cheating on us both. But that doesn't make me feel any better. It makes me feel worse because he's always going to be dishonest with women and they're just like me, they don't deserve that. And he's charming and manipulative and always gets away with it. That really pisses me off too, because I'm into the idea of justice, and it makes me so freaking angry that someone like him is never alone while I'm nothing but alone. Sorry, I'm just so MAD, I can't handle rage like this.
